description: Holy-Paladin-with-Discipline-flavor healer - Bless tags one ally to unlock a dedicated Blessing line (Purity/Retribution/Triumph/Absolution), while Illumination/Shine/Daybreak/Radiant Cascade cover the rest of the group.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc + confirmed screenshot numbers (Vow of Grace, Devotion of Grace confirmed as class-wide; Daybreak, Radiant Cascade confirmed via screenshot as Blessings-locked). Real mechanic per handoff: Bless tags one ally (never yourself), unlocking the Blessing family of protection spells - Purity is full damage immunity, Retribution deflects the next harmful spell, Triumph is an enrage-with-safety-net, Absolution lets the Blessed ally unleash a Holy burst.

nodes.name: Blessings
nodes.description: Increases healing power from Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Blessings - Level 15 Passive. Healing power from Intellect.'

nodes.name: Ancient Rites
nodes.description: Increases Intellect by 3 per rank and periodically regenerates mana.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts Intellect; periodic mana regen (% of max).'

nodes.name: Sunlight Refraction
nodes.description: Increases Illumination healing by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Daybreak
nodes.description: Learn Daybreak, a charge-based heal.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 24, '2 Charges, 10 sec recharge, healing an ally for 273.' Covers instant-heal gaps between GCDs.

nodes.name: Sunwalker
nodes.description: Each Shine grants Sunwalker, increasing your healing done by 3% for 5 turns and stacking up to 5 times.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Reduces next Shine's cast time + mana cost, stacking.'

nodes.name: Luminary Mendicant
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of Illumination by 3% per rank.

nodes.name: Heat Wave
nodes.description: Your Illumination and Shine splash 30% of their healing to up to 3 nearby allies.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Illumination/Shine healing splashes to target's nearby allies.'

nodes.name: Sunshine
nodes.description: Learn Sunshine, a heal-over-time on an ally.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Ally HoT.'

nodes.name: Bless
nodes.description: Place Bless on an ally (never yourself), applying a heal-over-time and unlocking the Blessing spell family for them.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as this spec's signature mechanic: 'HoT on an ally, one target at a time.' The Blessed ally is who Purity/Retribution/Triumph/Absolution can target.

nodes.name: Blessing of Purity
nodes.description: The Blessed ally becomes immune to all damage for a window, but their own damage and healing done is reduced. Only usable on the Blessed ally.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Blessed ally immune to all damage for a window, but their own damage+healing reduced. Only on Blessed ally.' Real full-immunity cooldown.

nodes.name: Blessing of Retribution
nodes.description: Teaches Blessing of Retribution, which deflects the next harmful spell cast on a Blessed ally.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Deflects the next harmful spell on Blessed ally within a window. Only on Blessed ally.'

nodes.name: Blessing of Triumph
nodes.description: The Blessed ally gains Haste and damage. If they drop below 35% health while active, they heal for a percentage of direct damage dealt for the remainder.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Blessed ally: +haste, +damage; if they drop below 35%, heals them for % of direct damage dealt for remainder. Only on Blessed ally.'

nodes.name: Blessing of Absolution
nodes.description: The Blessed ally unleashes a frontal Holy burst and generates threat. Only usable on the Blessed ally.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 22, 'Empower a Blessed ally to unleash a burst of holy energy in front of them, dealing 66 Holy damage to enemies in a 10 yd frontal cone and generating additional threat. Only usable on your ally with Bless active.'

nodes.name: Sun Worship
nodes.description: Increases healing power and spell haste rating from Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Level 20 Passive. Healing power + spell haste rating from Intellect.'

nodes.name: Sunlight
nodes.description: Your Dawn also heals your most wounded ally for 220.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 10 Passive. Fulfilling Vow unleashes healing to lowest-health nearby allies.'

nodes.name: Radiant Cascade
nodes.description: Learn Radiant Cascade, a beam heal that bounces to additional allies for reduced value per bounce.
nodes._source: Confirmed screenshot: Lvl 30, 'Refract light into a restorative beam, healing an ally for 207, and then jumps to up to 4 additional allies, healing for less with each bounce.' Blessings' real spread-heal tool.

nodes.name: Cultivate Divinity
nodes.description: Illumination and Radiant Cascade have a 6% chance per rank to increase your healing done by 15% for 2 turns.

nodes.name: Hope
nodes.description: Your healing spells have a 15% chance to reduce the cooldown of Daybreak by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Crit heals reduce Solar Invocation cooldown (limited frequency).'

nodes.name: The Redeemer
nodes.description: Your healing spells have a 25% chance to wrap you in a ward absorbing damage equal to 8% of your maximum Health.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 50 Passive. Crit heal grants target a delayed heal-on-next-damage (30% of original).' Real Atonement-adjacent capstone.

nodes.name: Angelic Touch
nodes.description: Increases all healing done by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Boosts healing done.'

nodes.name: Lead Me Not Astray
nodes.description: Increases Bless's healing-over-time effectiveness by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Doubles Bless healing' (scaled down to a percentage rank-up here rather than a flat double, to fit the standard rank-scaling pattern used across every other class this session).

nodes.name: Savior
nodes.description: Increases healing done to targets below 20% health by 4% per rank.

nodes.name: Vitality
nodes.description: Increases Stamina and Spirit by 1% per rank. Your heals grant a further 5% Stamina and Spirit for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Effective healing boosts your Stamina + Spirit, stacking.'

nodes.name: Stalwart
nodes.description: Being struck hardens you, reducing damage taken by 25% for 2 turns. Cannot occur more than once every 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Melee crits against you prevent being crit again (briefly).' CORRECTED 5 Nov 2026: carried crit_taken_reduction=100 in a proc's stat_mods, which is NOT readable from a status effect - it is read via target.get_talent_effect (abilities.py:1317), the TALENT channel, while a status effect's stat_mods go to get_status_stat_mod. So crit immunity was silent dead data. There is no status-channel crit-immunity key at all, so it becomes a flat damage reduction and the description says so rather than promising immunity it cannot deliver. BARE damage_taken_pct is read RAW on both sides, so -0.25 is -25%. This tree has no builder script; patched in data directly.

nodes.name: Revivify
nodes.description: Learn Revivify, a battle resurrection. Usable only out of combat.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Battle-rez. Out of combat.'

nodes.name: Solar Priest
nodes.description: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 2% per rank. Your heals generate 1 Solar Power, no more than once every 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Reduces Solar Invigoration cooldown; Shine effective-heal casts Illumination (limited frequency).'

nodes.name: Harmonious Bells
nodes.description: Sanctify has a 33% chance per rank to also heal your most wounded ally for 60.

nodes.name: Radiant Zeal
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Authored 6 Nov. Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.' Mirrors priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury, both of which are WoW-accurate at 5 x 20%. Placed on tier 4 beside the existing tier-4 block; connected_to is cosmetic (it draws the edge), spending is gated by tier_requirements.
